text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Eishin Flash received high marks, 
it was merely a lukewarm evaluation, 
limited strictly to "among this lineup's 
runners."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, neither feeling down nor overly 
pressured, Eishin Flash kept her eyes on 
the road ahead, running to connect toward 
the Satsuki Sho.
